articles.title_en: ‘Escalation is becoming a fact’: Tusk says Russia may target Ukrainian border crossings after drones hit a Kyiv–Warsaw train and nearby gas station
articles.lead_en: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk held a special briefing after Russian forces launched drone strikes just a few miles from the Ukrainian-Polish border. On the morning of September 13, one drone struck a gas station a few miles from the border, while another hit the locomotive of a passenger train.
